mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 950 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million dollars indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 950 and RSAFS < 370000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and GDPC1 quarterly growth negative), a reduction in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary stimulus that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when recession condition is met and FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdowns materialize.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts falling below 950 thousand units signals a slowdown in the housing market, a key driver of consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is below 950.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) below 138,000 thousand and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.3% indicates a severe economic contraction where monetary policy responds to labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS < 138000 and FEDFUNDS < 2.3.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market rapidly prices in the monetary policy easing, with short-term volatility amplifying the reaction.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months.
